name: restruct/silverstripe-404logger
description: Find broken inbound links: logs 404s with referrer and hit count, drops scanner noise, and reports them in the CMS with bulk ignore and redirect. Also logs site searches

suggest.silverstripe/reports: Shows the logged 404s and search queries as CMS reports
suggest.silverstripe/cms: Enables logging of front-end search queries (SearchQueryLogger)
suggest.silverstripe/siteconfig: Enables the CMS-editable 404 ignore list (Settings) and the report's ignore action
suggest.silverstripe/redirectedurls: Enables the report's bulk action that creates redirects for broken links
